items.information: ![Image description](https://i.ibb.co/5KGbmHK/logo-nats-redes.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido al Venezuela Nationals 2023 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **100 competidores** para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2023#35632-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, puede ver la pestaña de [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2023#35646-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) o contactar al equipo organizador. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Venezuela Nationals 2023 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **100**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2023#35632-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, you can check [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2023#35646-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) or contact the organizing team. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Enrymar!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Venezuela%20Nationals%202023*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Rafael Antonio Sánchez: Teléfono: 0412-8571331 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584128571331&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Rafael!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Venezuela%20Nationals%202023*) rafaelmachele@gmail.com

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE5NzI3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2aa7d4e2e6549192f7bd3c15fb0a3b7facb6ceb1/Logo%20Nationals%202025%20(2).png) ## Bienvenido al Venezuela Nationals 2025 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **100** competidores para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025#63905-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * **Todos los competidores recibirán un [Kit de regalo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025#64015-kit-de-competidor-competitor-kit) sin costo adicional.** Este kit incluye, entre otros artículos, la **camiseta oficial del Venezuela Nationals 2025.** Para asegurar que el competidor reciba la talla correcta, **es imprescindible que especifique su talla de camiseta en el campo de comentarios durante el proceso de [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025/register).** * Si tiene dudas, puede ver la pestaña de [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025#63906-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) o contactar al equipo organizador. ## Welcome to Venezuela Nationals 2025 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **100**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025#63905-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it. * **A [gift kit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025#64015-kit-de-competidor-competitor-kit) will be provided to all competitors at no additional cost.** It includes the **official Venezuela Nationals 2025 t-shirt** and other items. To ensure that the competitor receives the correct size, **it is necessary to specify their T-shirt size in the comments field during the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025/register) process.** * If you have any questions, you can check [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2025#63906-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) or contact the organizing team. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola,%20Enrymar!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20acerca%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Venezuela%20Nationals%202025*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Rafael Sanchez Teléfono: 0412-8571331 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584128571331&text=%C2%A1Hola,%20Rafael!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20acerca%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Venezuela%20Nationals%202025*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com
